message.jaymospowers.swallowed_power: You take in %1$s, and a piece of their %2$s with them: %3$s, on your heritage key when there's nothing to swallow in sight. (Until you die, or swallow another's.)
message.jaymospowers.open_menu: (Press H to see what it does.)
message.jaymospowers.stirring_soon: The feeling is overwhelming. It's almost here.
message.jaymospowers.creative_only: Powers can only be chosen in Creative. In Survival, yours will awaken on its own.
commands.jaymospowers.get_none: %s has no power yet (awakens in about %s seconds of survival play)
screen.jaymospowers.title: Powers
screen.jaymospowers.dormant: Your power is still dormant. Keep surviving and it will awaken.
message.jaymospowers.meditate.locked: Learn Meditation in the Survival tree (K) first.
message.jaymospowers.unlocked_chat: Your power grows: [%s] %s (hover, or see it on %s)
message.jaymospowers.locked: That ability is still locked. Keep using your power to unlock it.
screen.jaymospowers.hover_hint: Hover an ability to read it in full.
message.jaymospowers.corrupted_sub: Your power no longer feels like your own.
message.jaymospowers.purified_sub: Your power is yours again, and nothing can take it now.
screen.jaymospowers.affinity.title: Where does your power lie?
screen.jaymospowers.affinity.hint: Something sleeps inside you. Choose what it may become; it will wake in time.
screen.jaymospowers.affinity.sub: Chosen once. Whatever you pick still takes its time to wake.
screen.jaymospowers.affinity.pick: Click a power to pick it, then lean toward it; or let fate decide.
message.jaymospowers.affinity: You feel a pull toward %s. It will come, in time.
message.jaymospowers.affinity_fate: You leave it to fate. Whatever sleeps in you will choose for itself.
message.jaymospowers.carry.carrying: Right-click to put them down, sneak + right-click to throw
message.jaymospowers.carry.carried: %s has picked you up. Jump to break free!
message.jaymospowers.carry.lifting: It weighs nothing. Right-click to set it down, sneak + right-click to heave it
message.jaymospowers.carry.block: Right-click to place it where you look, sneak + right-click to throw it
message.jaymospowers.carry.no_room: No room there: look at a free spot within 3 blocks
message.jaymospowers.carry.part: Right-click to drop it, sneak + right-click to throw it
message.jaymospowers.carry.container: Right-click to place it where you look
button.jaymospowers.armor.head: helmet
message.jaymospowers.fracture.dazed: Your head rings from the blow
message.jaymospowers.beam_clash.locked: Beam clash! Mash your power key to push
message.jaymospowers.beam_clash.resting: You haven't got your breath back from the clash
message.jaymospowers.beam_clash.power_up: Your power surges into the clash!
hud.jaymospowers.beam_clash.title: Clash
screen.jaymospowers.toggle.mode.desc: Presses your Mode key (Z) for you.
screen.jaymospowers.toggle.mode.none.des: This power has nothing on its Mode key.
screen.jaymospowers.toggle.ultimate.desc: Presses your ultimate's key (C) for you.
screen.jaymospowers.toggle.ultimate.lock: Your ultimate comes once your power ascends.
screen.jaymospowers.toggle.mask.desc: Takes your costume's mask off, or puts it back on.
screen.jaymospowers.toggle.mask.locked: Wear a costume with a mask (a tailor makes them).
screen.jaymospowers.mastery.creative: Mastery grows as you use your power in survival.
screen.jaymospowers.mastery.skill_tree: Your skill tree is on K.
